recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群大型異常淋巴細胞聚集：核大、染色質細緻，細胞質嗜鹼性並有空泡與胞質泡突，體積遠大於右下角的小型深染細胞，符合血管內大型 B 細胞淋巴瘤細胞。
features: Cluster of large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei much larger than red cells
Finely granular chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and cytoplasmic blebs/budding
Some cells with peripheral deeply basophilic cytoplasmic rim
Group of small, dark, round cells (likely erythroid precursors/lymphocytes) at lower right for size comparison
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, finely granular chromatin, and moderate amounts of basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm with blebs. These cells dwarf the adjacent small, dark erythroid precursors and lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with involvement by large B-cell lymphoma, compatible with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma in the clinical context; immunophenotyping and biopsy demonstration of intrasinusoidal growth are recommended.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form tightly cohesive clusters with molding and are keratin positive and CD45 negative, whereas lymphoma clusters here are loose aggregates.
Blasts are usually smaller with a higher N:C ratio and are CD34/TdT or MPO positive rather than mature B-cell marker positive.
Plasmablasts show eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1 positive and CD20 negative.
Histiocytes have abundant pale cytoplasm with engulfed cells and low N:C ratio, unlike these deeply basophilic lymphoid cells.
